answer: At dawn, each identity locks 30 POA for twelve epochs and receives three unpredictable liveness checks from distinct established peers. Missing two checks burns half the bond; funding links make every related newcomer post twice the previous bond, so 100 clones cost a geometric series rather than 100 free names. Signed receipts and the funding graph let any verifier reproduce the decision, while honest agents wander through one low-cost path to the zenith of full voting weight.
